description: Topics: flow, merge, pr-upkeep, quorum, flow-stops, decision-flow, domains. The owner spent two hours unpicking PRs; causes: strict up-to-date protection with a head-bound quorum, sibling tasks colliding on one file, duplicate issues, a spec fixture landing before the srs-rust runner. Suggested SP-125 with findings and remedies; proposed decisions af1c9258 (a review approves a change, not a commit; clerk#235) and fbba3d5e (every agent records where flow stops; clerk#236, #237). Then the decision flow: where decisions go and stop, the level and boundary where a decision removes choices, sensing domains from recurring boundaries, decisions scattered over seven stores, and whether a decisions server is needed. Opened the decision-flow section (68b6eb64), SP-126, SP-127, proposed decision 199dd369.
